valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E: FY2027 non-GAAP diluted EPS (viewed at the Nov 2027 target date) x justified multiple. Base: 9M 2026 non-GAAP EPS $43.70 (Q3 $20.07) implies FY2026 about $63 assuming Q4 near $19; FY2027 EPS $66 is my estimate on ~108M diluted shares, ~15% tax, 86% gross margin, R&D about $6.1B, SG&A about $2.45B per company guidance. Net cash about $16.1B (cash $18.9B less $2.0B debt and $0.7B finance leases) is about $150/share and is within the multiple. EPS and multiples are my estimates; no full-year EPS guidance was published.

bear.driver: Eylea HD and Dupixent royalties disappoint, pipeline setbacks, pricing pressure

base.driver: Dupixent royalty and Eylea HD growth offset by opex growth; modest pipeline contribution

bull.driver: Strong Dupixent/Eylea HD, cemdisiran and pipeline wins, buybacks

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $66 the close implies 14.5x; the simple average of the three sourced targets ($872) implies 13.2x or EPS about $62 at 14x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $66 (6.9 pp of the close)
valuation.watch_metric: Non-GAAP EPS run-rate (Q3 $20.07) with Dupixent collaboration profit and Eylea HD net sales, plus the cemdisiran FDA decision
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and FY2026 results, expected late Jan/early Feb 2027

analyst_notes: Only three firms' calls were found with dates (Guggenheim, Citigroup, Canaccord), none after the Oct 30 Q3 beat, so the sample is stale and thin; targets were mostly set pre-earnings with the stock lower. The $872 average sits below the close and implies a lower multiple (13.2x) than the base case; post-Q3 target raises are likely but were not sourced. Horizon is undocumented for all, so none enters the weighted target.
